name: Rishi Ganga lake outburst
summary: Illustrative what-if inspired by the February 2021 Chamoli disaster: a landslide dam on the Rishi Ganga above Raini fails, and the outburst flood runs down the Dhauliganga past Tapovan to Vishnuprayag near Joshimath.

dem.source: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data; SRTM, NASA / USGS), zoom 13, box-filtered to 60 m

notes: Blockage height and lake volume are illustrative, not survey values. Edit them in Event to explore other cases.
